seo.title: Building in the Kootenays | Suppliers and Tradespeople
seo.description: Local building suppliers, trades and RDCK permit information for projects around Kootenay Lake, chosen by Kootenay Lake Carpentry.

headline: Building in the Kootenays.

items.name: RDCK building permit applications
items.text: Application forms, checklists and fees for the Regional District of Central Kootenay building department. Not sure which office covers your property? Ask the building department before you plan.

items.name: Kaslo Building Supplies
items.text: Kaslo's only full service building supply store. Lumber and building materials, with estimates and delivery.

items.name: Terus Construction
items.text: Ready-mix concrete and aggregates, plus road construction, paving, civil work and general contracting.

items.name: Brenton Industries
items.text: A Kaslo-based company doing land development and local services for residents, municipalities and governments.

items.name: Pace Electric
items.text: Licensed, insured and bonded electricians. Wiring, panel upgrades and repairs for homes and commercial buildings.

items.name: J.P. Insulating
items.text: An insulation contractor in Nelson serving the Kootenay region. Blown-in cellulose, foam board, batts, spray foam and vapour barriers.

items.name: Matrix Refrigeration
items.text: Heating, cooling and refrigeration for homes and businesses in Nelson and the Kootenay Lake region. Heat pumps, ductless mini-splits, furnaces and ventilation.

items.name: Ply Gem Canada windows
items.text: Vinyl, aluminum-clad vinyl and aluminum-clad wood windows made in Canada.

note: Last checked October 2026. Details change, so confirm hours, services and fees with each business or office.
